## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: Differ is a pure function: same (local_state, jira_state) input produces byte-identical canonical manifest across N=100 invocations (this task's dedicated stress assertions; task-4's diff implementation provides the in-code mechanism — this task verifies it behaviorally)

Add dedicated tests test_differ_is_pure_across_100_invocations and test_differ_is_pure_across_input_permutations: (a) build non-trivial (local_state, jira_state) fixture covering all 10 valid (direction, action) pairs from _VALID_COMBINATIONS; (b) call diff() 100 times, assert all returned manifests serialize to the same hash; (c) permute the input dict ordering 100 times (preserving semantic content via list-of-tuple input + dict construction), assert hash is identical across permutations.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a non-trivial (local_state, jira_state) fixture covering all valid (direction, action) pairs; When diff() is called 100 times; Then all 100 returned lists serialize to the same canonical hash. AND Given the same fixture with 100 random dict-key permutations on local_state and jira_state; When diff() is called on each permutation; Then all 100 returned hashes are identical.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py
- [ ] 100-invocation purity test passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py::test_differ_is_pure_across_100_invocations
- [ ] 100-permutation input-order independence passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py::test_differ_is_pure_across_input_permutations

## File Impact
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py — Edit (append stress tests)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
